format: Crunch Fitness health club (approx. 20,000 to 60,000 sq ft, generally leased)

invest.quote: The total investment necessary to begin operation of a Crunch Fitness health club franchise is $2,147,500 to $5,367,000.  This includes $35,000 to $55,000 that must be paid to the franchisor or affiliate.

fee.quote: The initial fee you will pay under the Franchise Agreement ("Initial Franchise Fee") will be $35,000 regardless of whether you will open a Crunch Fitness or a Crunch Select health club
fee.note: Development Fee or Multi-Unit Fee of $35,000 per club replaces the Initial Franchise Fee. Reduced, waived or deferred fees possible (large developers, veterans, new markets); in 2025 new franchisees paid $0 to $35,000. Opening extension fee $5,000 per 30-day extension.

royalty.quote: Royalty 5.0% of monthly Gross Sales.(2) By the 5th day of the following calendar month.

adFund.quote: Brand Marketing Fund Contribution 2% of monthly Gross Sales but we have the right to charge a pro rata share of actual marketing expenses instead.(2)
adFund.note: Local advertising: the lesser of (1) 7% of Gross Sales (incl. personal training) or (2) by club age: 1-24 months greater of $10,000 or 8% of Gross Sales (excl. personal training); 25-72 months greater of $8,000 or 7%; over 72 months greater of $10,000 or 5%. Brand Marketing Fund does not offset local spend.

otherRecurring.name: Club Management Software System (ABC)
otherRecurring.amount: $159 per month to ABC plus transaction processing fees

otherRecurring.name: Local Advertising
otherRecurring.amount: The lesser of 7% of Gross Sales or an age-based minimum (greater of $8,000-$10,000 or 5%-8% of Gross Sales excl. personal training), monthly

transferFee.amount: For Franchise Agreements: $10,000 if there is a Change in Control, or $1,000 if there is no Change in Control, and in each case, our actual cost, including legal fees, if higher.

item19.quote: Of the 111 locations in the middle third of the Franchise clubs, 62 locations, or 56%, are below the average and 49 locations, or 44%, are above the average.  The median for this group was $2,848,462.
item19.note: Crunch Fitness format only; 331 of 352 qualified domestic franchised clubs (94%) submitted financials. Gross Revenue includes membership, personal training and retail, less sales taxes, refunds and discounts. An EBITDA operating statement by club age (12-59 months, 167 clubs) is described but its table is not in the extracted text.
